visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Handle Each Run as a Unit
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A loop compares each character with the previous one and has to write the last run after the loop ends. Use nested loops that handle one whole run at a time inside an encode function. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The old loop runs one step past the end of the string to flush the last run. Handling a run at a time separates "count the run" from "write the run".
